Figures describe La Plagne's own area. Search summary of the official ticket site and guides (skibeat, heidi.com, snowtrex): 225 km, 139 runs; 82 lifts 'including' 5 magic carpets, 27 drag lifts and rope tows, 29 chairlifts, 10 gondolas and 3 cable cars (these add up to 74; the other 8 are not broken down); another guide says 77 lifts. Total capacity 139,367 passengers/hour. Linked Paradiski (with Les Arcs via the Vanoise Express double-deck cable car): 425 km, 258 runs = 19 green, 128 blue, 77 red, 34 black, 129 lifts.

Piste reference data — confirm at source. Only features Piste is confident about are set; everything else is unknown (null), not 'not offered'. Ski schools (e.g. ESF) and rental shops operate in the resort villages

character: La Plagne is a group of ten villages, from purpose-built high stations such as Plagne Centre and Belle Plagne to lower traditional villages such as Montchavin-Les Coches and Champagny, with about 225 km of its own pistes up to the Bellecôte glacier. The Vanoise Express cable car links it to Les Arcs to form Paradiski (about 425 km).
learning: Reference: the high villages have beginner areas at the door and much blue terrain; confirm free or discounted beginner lifts and lessons for 2026-27.
